title: Form translation units after conditional inclusion
conditions: A source file includes other files and uses conditional directives.
exceptions: Physical files are not required to correspond one-to-one with translation units.
rule: The translation unit includes the included text and excludes conditionally skipped source lines.
cpg_consequence: Keep active text separate from retained inactive-source provenance.

proposed_checks.description: Include a declaration from a header and skip another under #if 0; only the active declaration participates in the translation unit.

title: Map physical source and preserve UCN equivalence
exceptions: Internal encoding need not literally store a UCN sequence.
rule: Use the documented source mapping, normalize line-end indicators, and handle an extended character equivalently to its universal-character-name.
cpg_consequence: Retain physical ranges alongside logical characters; range storage is CPG policy.

proposed_checks.description: Compare an accepted extended character with its UCN spelling under one source profile; logical meaning agrees while physical spans differ.

title: Splice adjacent backslash and newline
exceptions: Do not rescan resulting text as phase-1 trigraph input.
rule: Delete each immediately adjacent backslash-newline pair to form logical lines.
cpg_consequence: Keep mapping across deleted physical characters.

proposed_checks.description: The identifier parts longna and me separated by backslash-newline form longname; a space after the backslash prevents this splice.

title: Classify UCN creation by splicing as undefined
conditions: Splicing produces a sequence matching UCN syntax.
exceptions: This is not a required-diagnostic case merely because it arose during translation.
cpg_consequence: An optional warning must not promise an ISO-mandated output.

proposed_checks.description: Split the characters of a UCN across a backslash-newline pair; classify the newly formed sequence without assigning a required translation result.

title: Classify invalid source termination as undefined
conditions: A nonempty source lacks a final newline or ends with backslash immediately before its final newline.
exceptions: An empty source does not satisfy the nonempty-file condition.
rule: Behavior is undefined for these source endings.
cpg_consequence: Record any recovery as policy rather than normative acceptance.

proposed_checks.description: Compare empty input, a newline-terminated declaration, and the same declaration without its final newline; the last has no fixed ISO outcome.

title: Retain newlines and document whitespace normalization
conditions: Phase 3 decomposes text into preprocessing tokens and whitespace.
exceptions: Comment replacement is separately covered by requirement 000002.
rule: Retain newlines; retaining or collapsing other nonempty whitespace runs is implementation-defined.
cpg_consequence: Preserve physical source positions even when logical whitespace is normalized.

proposed_checks.description: For token, tab-space run, token, newline, compare retained versus collapsed spacing under a declared policy; the separating newline remains.

title: Apply preprocessing recursively to included input
conditions: Phase 4 executes directives and expands macro invocations.
exceptions: Detailed substitution, search and conditional rules remain separate.
rule: Process included files recursively through phases 1–4.
cpg_consequence: Do not feed included raw bytes directly into the final parser.

proposed_checks.description: An included header containing a trigraph-produced directive must undergo early phases before its macro is used by the including file.

title: Classify UCN creation by token pasting as undefined
conditions: Phase-4 token concatenation produces a sequence matching UCN syntax.
exceptions: This card does not prescribe an error or result for other token-pasting failures.
rule: Behavior is undefined for that generated sequence.
cpg_consequence: Track the paste origin for optional diagnostics.

proposed_checks.description: Construct a preprocessing test that joins UCN fragments; assert classification only, never a mandatory resulting identifier.

title: Convert literal characters to the execution set
conditions: Phase 5 processes character and string literals.
exceptions: Representability details and literal-specific rules remain with the literal clauses.
rule: Convert source characters, escape sequences and UCNs within literals to execution character-set members.
cpg_consequence: Keep execution encoding separate from source decoding.

proposed_checks.description: Under a documented profile, compare equivalent literal character and UCN spellings; do not assume host encoding values.

title: Concatenate adjacent literals of matching width
conditions: Phase 6 receives adjacent ordinary literals or adjacent wide literals.
exceptions: Mixed ordinary/wide sequences are outside this card.
cpg_consequence: Represent the combined value while preserving constituent source spans.

proposed_checks.description: "red" "oak" becomes the same sequence as "redoak"; test the corresponding pair of wide literals independently.

title: Analyze tokens after preprocessing
exceptions: Whitespace already mattered to preprocessing and token boundaries.
rule: Convert preprocessing tokens into tokens and perform syntactic and semantic analysis; separating whitespace is no longer significant.
cpg_consequence: Retain written spelling as provenance without reinterpreting whitespace as an operator.

proposed_checks.description: Two valid token streams differing only in separating spaces have the same syntax; this does not permit merging adjacent identifier tokens.

title: Perform required template instantiations
conditions: Combining translated units and instantiation units.
exceptions: This does not require instantiating unused templates.
rule: Determine required instantiations, locate template definitions and perform them; requiring the original definition-source units is implementation-defined.
cpg_consequence: Retain requirements and definition provenance across units.

proposed_checks.description: One used specialization creates an instantiation obligation; an unrelated unused template does not create one merely by existing.

title: Reject failed required instantiation as ill-formed
exceptions: General no-diagnostic exceptions still govern any diagnostic claim.
cpg_consequence: Separate a recorded instantiation failure from successful parsing of template syntax.

proposed_checks.description: Given an established failing required instantiation, do not label the complete program well-formed just because its generic declaration parsed.

title: Resolve external references when forming a program
conditions: Phase 9 combines translator output into a program image.
exceptions: A partial analyzer graph is not an already-linked executable.
rule: Resolve external object/function references and use library components for definitions absent from the current translation.

proposed_checks.description: Two units where one refers to a function defined in the other must resolve that reference when forming the complete program.

title: Replace the defined trigraph set
conditions: Phase 1 encounters a defined trigraph sequence.
exceptions: Do not apply a later language edition that removed trigraphs.
rule: Replace it by the corresponding character from the original-edition trigraph set.
cpg_consequence: Preserve the original three-character span independently of replacement spelling.

proposed_checks.description: Use int data??(3??); as an independent bracket case; test every defined pair against the existing nine-pair lexer assertion.

title: Leave other question marks unchanged
conditions: A question mark does not begin a defined trigraph.
exceptions: Recognize actual trigraphs before line splicing, as requirement 000001 states.
cpg_consequence: Do not implement arbitrary question-mark substitutions.

proposed_checks.description: For the phase-1 fragment ??q, keep all three characters; do not invent a replacement or claim the fragment is a valid complete program.

title: Terminate line comments at the next logical newline
conditions: A // comment is recognized after splicing.
exceptions: A physical newline already deleted by splicing cannot terminate it.
rule: End the comment at the next newline; comment-like delimiters inside it are ordinary comment content.
cpg_consequence: Keep physical continuation ranges even when logical text is removed.

proposed_checks.description: A // comment ending in backslash-newline consumes the next physical line up to its logical newline; an embedded /* does not open a nested comment.

title: Restrict text after form feed or vertical tab
conditions: A // comment contains form feed or vertical tab before its terminating newline.
exceptions: Ordinary line comments without these controls are unaffected.
rule: Only whitespace may follow that control character before the terminating newline; violating this rule needs no diagnostic.
cpg_consequence: Distinguish optional recovery warnings from required diagnostics.

proposed_checks.description: Compare //, vertical-tab, spaces, newline with //, vertical-tab, letter, newline; only the latter violates this restriction.
